episodes.synopsis: After his untimely death, our unlikely hero finds himself in another world, reincarnated as a vending machine. Now his life revolves around selling things to people, but he's stuck in the middle of nowhere with no sign of any customers.
episodes.title: The Vending Machine Travels

episodes.synopsis: The Hunters Association hires Lammis and Boxxo to provide food during a frog fiend hunt, with a ragtag group acting as their bodyguards. But things turn ominous when the fiends prove to be more numerous than expected.
episodes.title: The King Frog Fiend Appears

episodes.synopsis: The expedition returns to find the village has been attacked, but fortunately the damage is limited. Boxxo and Lammis discover they both have plenty of ways to help during the recovery effort.
episodes.title: Rebuilding

episodes.synopsis: A gang of thieves carts Boxxo away so they can extract his money, but the real surprise turns out to be the individual who's supposed to figure out how to pull off the theft.
episodes.title: Boxxo Is Abducted

episodes.synopsis: Boxxo is already well known throughout the village for the items he's sold to date, and now he begins to find new ways to assist various residents with their problems.
episodes.title: Vanity, Pride, and Vending Machine

episodes.synopsis: Boxxo falls into a new stratum, and there he has an unexpected encounter with some hungry hunters who think he's nothing more than a convenient magic item.
episodes.title: The Fighting Vending Machine

episodes.synopsis: Boxxo falls into a new stratum, and there he has an unexpected encounter with some hungry hunters who think he's nothing more than a convenient magic item.
episodes.title: The Voracious Devils

episodes.synopsis: Boxxo, Lammis, and a large formidable group go on a campaign in the Labyrinth stratum to defeat the local stratum lord. Meanwhile, Kerioyl reveals his reasons for targeting such foes in the first place.
episodes.title: The Flame Skeletitan of the Labyrinth Stratum

episodes.synopsis: Director Bear commissions Boxxo, Lammis, Hulemy, and the Band of Gluttons to survey the exterior of the labyrinth. Joining them is a powerful hunter who has more going on than meets the eye.
episodes.title: A Less-Than-Ideal Hero

episodes.synopsis: Munami and the Restaurant Union decide to hold an eating contest, but that's a risky venture given the appetites of some of the locals. Can Boxxo save the day once again?
episodes.title: Gastric Measures

episodes.synopsis: Captain Kerioyl wants a group to explore the Dead's Lament stratum and eventually defeat its stratum lord, but there's a big problem. Lammis can't cope with the scary monsters inhabiting the place!
episodes.title: The Dead's Lament Stratum

episodes.synopsis: Boxxo and friends track down the King of Souls stratum lord and launch an attack on him. But they face their greatest trial yet when the plan goes badly off the rails.
episodes.title: What Can Be Done as a Vending Machine
